macros.name: arraytostring
macros.doc: The macro \arraytostring{⟨arrayname⟩}{⟨result⟩} assumes that ⟨arrayname⟩ is an array of characters, and defines the macro ⟨result⟩ to be that sequence of characters.

macros.name: checkarrayindex
macros.doc: \checkarrayindex{⟨arrayname⟩}{⟨index⟩} checks if ⟨arrayname⟩ is an array and if ⟨index⟩ is a valid index for the array.

macros.name: checkifinteger
macros.doc: \checkifinteger{⟨num⟩} checks if ⟨num⟩ is an integer (not less than zero).

macros.name: flagverse
macros.doc: \flagverse{⟨flag⟩} inserts ⟨flag⟩ at the left (of a line).

macros.name: getarrayelement
macros.doc: \getarrayelement{⟨arrayname⟩}{⟨index⟩}{⟨result⟩} sets the parameterless macro ⟨result⟩ to the contents of the ⟨index⟩ location in the ⟨arrayname⟩ array.

macros.name: indentpattern
macros.doc: The indentation pattern for a patverse environment is specified via the \indentpattern{⟨digits⟩} command.

macros.name: newarray
macros.doc: \newarray{⟨arrayname⟩}{⟨low⟩}{⟨high⟩} defines the ⟨arrayname⟩ array, where ⟨arrayname⟩ is a name like MyArray.

macros.name: poemlines
macros.doc: Use the \poemlines{⟨N⟩} command to number every ⟨N⟩th line of a poem.

macros.name: poemtitle
macros.doc: Use the \poemtitle{⟨title⟩} command (just before the verse environment) to give each poem a title; commands are provided to adjust the formatting and include the poem into the standard table of contents.

macros.name: poemtitlefont
macros.doc: This macro specifies the font and positioning of the poem title.

macros.name: poemtoc
macros.doc: The kind of entry made in the ToC by the \poemtitle command is defined by \poemtoc.

macros.name: setarrayelement
macros.doc: \setarrayelement{⟨arrayname⟩}{⟨index⟩}{⟨text⟩} sets the ⟨index⟩ location in the ⟨arrayname⟩ array to be ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: setverselinenums
macros.doc: The command \setverselinenums{⟨firstlinenum⟩}{⟨startnumsat⟩} can be used to set the number of the first verse line to ⟨firstlinenum⟩ instead of the default ‘1’ and to specify that the first printed line number should be for line number ⟨startnumsat⟩.

macros.name: stanzaskip
macros.doc: \stanzaskip controls the space between stanzas.

macros.name: stringtoarray
macros.doc: \stringtoarray{⟨arrayname⟩}{⟨string⟩} puts each character from ⟨string⟩ sequentially into the ⟨arrayname⟩ array, starting at index 1.

macros.name: verselinebreak
macros.doc: Using the command \verselinebreak[⟨length⟩] will cause later text in the line of the verse to be typeset indented on the following line.

macros.name: verselinenumbersleft
macros.doc: If you want line numbers set at the left use the \verselinenumbersleft declaration.

macros.name: verselinenumfont
macros.doc: \verselinenumfont Set the font for line numbers.

macros.name: vgap
macros.doc: The length \vgap is used as the basis for spacing.

macros.name: vindent
macros.doc: When a verse line is too long to fit within the typeblock it is wrapped onto the next line with a space, given by the value of the length \vindent.

envs.name: altverse
envs.doc: Each stanza within a verse may optionally be surrounded by either an altverse or patverse environment to effect specific typesetting; altverse indents every second line of a stanza, and patverse allows arbitrary indentation based on the ⟨pattern⟩ given by \indentpattern{⟨pattern⟩}.

envs.name: patverse
envs.doc: Each stanza within a verse may optionally be surrounded by either an altverse or patverse environment to effect specific typesetting; altverse indents every second line of a stanza, and patverse allows arbitrary indentation based on the ⟨pattern⟩ given by \indentpattern{⟨pattern⟩}.

envs.name: verse
envs.doc: The length parameter, if given, should be about the length of an average line, and then the entire contents will be typeset with the mid point of the length centered horizontally on the page.
